question: Does knowledge of the pentad confer the status of guru?
premises: A person may know the pentad.
Knowledge of this pentad is presented as decisive.
Such a knower is declared a guru.
inference: Knowing the pentad qualifies a person to be declared a guru.
uncertainties: The specific contents of the pentad are not identified in this verse.
plain_english: O goddess, O beloved, whoever knows the pentad is declared to be a guru.
